about:
Apogee Foods operates from Dallas, Texas, positioning itself as a natural foods manufacturing partner for quality-conscious brands. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in available sources.

The facility produces extruded products and chocolate-enrobed items, offering gluten-free, SQF-certified, and kosher-certified manufacturing. Specific details on plant size, headcount, annual volumes, or part-number counts are not provided.

Apogee serves brands seeking certified natural-food production, with capabilities in extrusion and chocolate enrobing. Customer types are described broadly as quality-conscious brands; no specific industry verticals or named clients appear in the source data.

The company emphasizes its certifications — SQF, kosher, and gluten-free — as markers of its manufacturing standards. No further stated mission or differentiation beyond these certifications is documented.
